title: Albany, GA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Albany, GA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Albany is a city in GA with a population of 75,000. Southwest Georgia hub with the Flint River, Ray Charles Plaza, and agricultural roots. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
